events.title: Fox Stamps Demo Released
events.summary: 🦨​​Check out 30 puzzles in this nonogram game designed to be approachable for new players and long time players alike!​Be sure to also check out our previous puzzle game Blobun, which is on a 45% discount right now:Please be sure to let us know what you think, thank you!

events.title: Introducing Fox Stamps!
events.summary: ​🦨​Fox Stamps is a nonogram game which aims to be approachable to new players as well as long time fans of the genre! In it, you solve puzzles by using the hints along the left and top of the puzzle, and when you've solved them, they turn into stamps.Please check it out below here on Steam, and get ready for the demo to come out on September 7th 2026. Thank you!​
